CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_8q_adl(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0270 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0271 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0272 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0273 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	target_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	1B0271_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0272_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0273_1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	target_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	1B0271_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0272_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0273_2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	target_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0270_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0271_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0272_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0273_3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_8q_adl WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_8q_adl (
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT p.cid) target

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270','1B0271','1B0272','1B0273')  ,t.cid,NULL)) result
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0270
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0271')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0271
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0272')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0272
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0273')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0273

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280') ,l.cid,NULL)) result_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0270_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0271')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0271_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0272')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0272_1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0273')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0273_1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1281') ,l.cid,NULL)) result_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=2 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0270_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=2 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0271')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0271_2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=2 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0272')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0272_2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND t.adl=3 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0272')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0272_3

INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN tmp_specialpp_9q q  ON p.cid=q.cid AND q.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d

GROUP BY h.hoscode
);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT p.hospcode, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,p.DISCHARGE
,p.age_y
,IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280'),'ติดสังคม',
	IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1281'),'ติดบ้าน',
	IF(l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1281'),'ติดเตียง',''
))) AS adl
,IF(q.2q=1,'ผล2Q ผิดปกติ','') AS 2q
,IF(q.9q=1,'ผล9Q ผิดปกติ','') AS 9q
,t.DATE_SERV,t.PPSPECIAL,t.PPSPLACE,t.HOSPCODE AS input_hosp
,IF(q.9q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270','1B0271','1B0272','1B0273') ,'ได้รับการประเมิน','') result
FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN tmp_specialpp_9q q  ON p.cid=q.cid AND q.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
LEFT JOIN t_adl_last_regist l ON p.cid=l.cid AND l.PPSPECIAL in('1B1280','1B1281','1B1282')
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_8q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9)
AND p.age_y >=60 
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA,d.DISCHARGE
,d.age_y,d.adl,d.DATE_SERV,d.PPSPECIAL,d.PPSPLACE,d.input_hosp,d.result,d.2q,d.9q
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}
